scenarios.stdout:
- the web address (public_host)
- the certificate file (tls_cert)
- the private key file (tls_key)
- the client ID (client_id)
- the provider's issuer URL (oidc_issuer)
- confirmation that everything on /dev/sdc may be erased (storage_confirm)
- the client secret (client_secret)
